outputs.explanation: This is a mass spectrum (line/intensity trace) showing raw relative intensity vs mass; it is a line-type plot of raw data, not a bar chart of averaged replicate values, so overlaying individual data points is not applicable/needed.
Same as panel A: a native MS spectrum trace showing raw relative intensity vs mass for a single sample, not an averaged bar/summary plot requiring individual points.

Bar chart showing the proportion of protein population bound to specific metal-atom numbers, derived directly from native MS peak intensities (as in A/B) for a single measurement per condition; there are no error bars and no indication of replicate averaging, so this is a single-experiment proportion (analogous to a percentage/pie-style summary) rather than a mean across replicates, and individual data points are not applicable.
Same type of native MS-derived proportion bar chart as panel C, with no error bars, representing a single-experiment measurement rather than an average of replicates.

Bar chart of chemical shift perturbation (CSP) per residue at three metal equivalents; each bar is a single measured chemical shift difference from one NMR titration experiment, not a mean of replicates, and no error bars are shown, so individual data points are not applicable.
